I couldn't find an Alberta figure, so I can't give you one. I searched Statistics Canada's tables for poverty by disability status at the provincial level.

The closest table is 11-10-0090-01, "Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status" (Canadian Income Survey). Its geography dimension is Canada only, with no provincial breakdown.

The national figure from that table is 12.6% of persons with disabilities aged 15 and over in poverty in 2024. This uses the Market Basket Measure (2023 base) for all persons. It was 12.8% in 2023 and 12.9% in 2022. I didn't retrieve the vector ID, so I can't cite one. This is a Canada-wide number and shouldn't be read as Alberta's.

I didn't find a province-level poverty table from the Canadian Survey on Disability (2022). I also didn't check Alberta's own open data portal. I'd rather not estimate an Alberta rate.

I couldn't get an Alberta poverty rate for people with disabilities, and I won't guess one.

**Where the figure should be:** Statistics Canada table 11-10-0090-01, "Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status". It comes from the Canadian Income Survey, is annual, and covers 2013 to 2024. The table was last released on 2026-04-29. The vector ID for Alberta is not known to me yet.

**Why I couldn't read it:**
- The tool that lists the table's dimensions returned an error.
- My one guess at the series coordinate for Alberta did not match any series.
- Without the dimension list, any other coordinate would be a blind guess.

**What to do next:** open table 11-10-0090-01 on statcan.gc.ca. Select Geography = Alberta, Disability status = persons with disabilities, and Indicator = Market Basket Measure (MBM) poverty rate. The latest reference period is 2024. If you send me the vector ID shown under "Add/Remove data", I can pull the values directly.

I also didn't use the 2022 Canadian Survey on Disability tables. None of the ones found has a poverty rate by province.

I couldn't find a poverty rate for people with disabilities in Alberta, so I'm not giving a figure.

- **Provincial data:** The closest official source is Statistics Canada table 11-10-0090-01, "Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status" (Canadian Income Survey, 2013–2024). Its geography dimension has only one member, Canada. It has no provincial breakdown, so it can't give Alberta.
- **Canada figure:** I also couldn't pull a national number. My queries for that table (the Market Basket Measure on 2018 and 2023 bases, and the after-tax Low Income Measure, for persons aged 15+) all returned empty results. I don't know why, and I haven't verified any figure from it.
- **Other tables:** My searches turned up no other Statistics Canada table that gives poverty or low income by disability status for Alberta. Table 11-10-0093-01 covers poverty by demographic characteristics but wasn't checked for a disability breakdown. I didn't find a figure from the Government of Alberta either.

For a custom provincial cut, you could try the Canadian Survey on Disability (Statistics Canada), or ask Statistics Canada for a custom tabulation of the Canadian Income Survey.
